transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get this package-lock meeting started. We need to review the release territory, running time, credits, and approval requirements for the live-concert documentary before I can authorize delivery. As a reminder, the streaming platform has requested a worldwide 68-minute master for delivery this Friday. The documentary is currently assembled at 68 minutes and has not yet been publicly released. I'd like each of the responsible production leads to report any outstanding requirements. Once all three leads have responded, I'll issue the formal settlement action and state the authorization decision so we can record the final package plan and action items before we wrap up today.

transcript.text: I need to flag two outstanding requirements on my end. First, I reviewed the executed music license this morning and confirmed that the featured song permits digital streaming only in the United States and Canada — not worldwide as the platform has requested. Second, that same license requires a cue sheet to be delivered with the authorized master. I have not yet entered either of these limits in the release tracker, so they are not reflected there.

I checked the archive-footage license exhibit with the post house today and confirmed that the finished program may not exceed exactly 52 minutes. Our current 68-minute assembly therefore cannot be delivered under the existing footage license, and I have not yet updated the runtime sheet to reflect this.
